# FreeTreeViewNode

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Tree Views](BlitzPlus-Tree-Views)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FreeTreeViewNode:Void node:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `node` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a node. |

## Description

Removes a node together with all nodes below it. The root must not be freed.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Free", 10, 10, 300, 200, Desktop(), 3)
tree = CreateTreeView(10, 10, 270, 140, win)
a = AddTreeViewNode("Keep", TreeViewRoot(tree))
b = AddTreeViewNode("Remove", TreeViewRoot(tree))
FreeTreeViewNode b
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
